Chief Justice's Court
Case :- Writ - C No. - 3812 of 2024

Petitioner :- Parvati Pandey
Respondent :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Alkshendra Nath Bajpai,Subedar Shukla

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Vaibhav Tripathi Hon'ble Arun Bhansali,Chief Justice Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State and Shri Vaibhav Tripathi, learned counsel appearing for respondent No. 4.
2.
This petition has been filed by the petitioner, aggrieved by the quantum of compensation paid to the petitioner for the acquisition of the land in question.

3. A perusal of the record indicates that the land in question have been acquired under the provisions of National Highways Act, 1956 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") and the petitioner is aggrieved of the compensation awarded.
The petitioner has a remedy under the Act to institute proceedings before the Arbitrator, which apparently has not been done by her.
